title: Sordland/Turn03/A_ReformistConstitution
description: Changes to the new constitution is presented.

entries.speaker: START
entries.title: START

entries.speaker: INPUT
entries.title: input

entries.speaker: OUTPUT
entries.title: output

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was walking to my office, since t..."
entries.dialogueText: I was walking to my office, since today was the day to edit and make the final changes for the proposal to change the Constitution of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Not long after, Petr, Lucian and Ni..."
entries.dialogueText: Not long after, Petr, Lucian and Nia arrived.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Greetings.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Greetings.”
entries.menuText: “Greetings.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Finally!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Finally!”
entries.menuText: “Finally!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked in the marble corridors of..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked in the marble corridors of the Palace, thinking about the huge decisions I was going to take.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the entrance to my office, my se..."
entries.dialogueText: At the entrance to my office, my secretary Livia greeted me.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Good morning, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Good morning! Time to finally get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning! Time to finally get this proposal going."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reform committee finally bore t..."
entries.dialogueText: The reform committee finally bore tangible results and the draft of the changes were about to be presented to me.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Good morning, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good morning, Livia.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good morning, Livia.”
entries.menuText: “Good morning, Livia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How are you today?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you today?"
entries.menuText: "How are you today?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Fine, thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine, thank you."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""More importantly, how are you, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "More importantly, how are you, sir?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""How are you today, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you today, sir?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm about to make stressful decisi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm about to make stressful decisions. So, not feeling that great.”
entries.menuText: “I'm about to make stressful decisions. So, not feeling that great.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm perfectly fine.""
entries.dialogueText: “I'm perfectly fine."
entries.menuText: “I'm perfectly fine."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I feel better now that I've seen y..."
entries.dialogueText: “I feel better now that I've seen you, Livia."
entries.menuText: “I feel better now that I've seen you, Livia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She averted her eyes away from me a..."
entries.dialogueText: She averted her eyes away from me and smiled.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Good to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to hear."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Sorry to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to hear."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Thank you, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You'll find out with the rest of S..."
entries.dialogueText: “You'll find out with the rest of Sordland, sweetheart."
entries.menuText: “You'll find out with the rest of Sordland, sweetheart."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll take that into consideration...."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll take that into consideration."
entries.menuText: “I'll take that into consideration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nothing's been decided yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing's been decided yet."
entries.menuText: "Nothing's been decided yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's none of your business, Livi..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's none of your business, Livia."
entries.menuText: “That's none of your business, Livia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia left to hang up my coat. I en..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia left to hang up my coat. I entered my office and sat down.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good morning everybody.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good morning everybody.”
entries.menuText: “Good morning everybody.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr placed the draft in front of m..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr placed the draft in front of me.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""After your modifications, we will..."
entries.dialogueText: "After your modifications, we will be starting the process."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After placing the committee's repor..."
entries.dialogueText: After placing the committee's report and my own notes in front of me, I buried myself in the papers.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I have suggested to bring some lim..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have suggested to bring some limitations to decrees regarding their applicability. While we keep them, we should try to make sure that they will only be used in emergency situations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Regardless of him, I see no proble..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless of him, I see no problem with having a special title for great heroes."
entries.menuText: "Regardless of him, I see no problem with having a special title for great heroes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's just a title, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's just a title, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "It's just a title, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. President. Unless you wish to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Unless you wish to be like Colonel Soll after all."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We could start talking about Secti..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could start talking about Section 3. This is about the impeachment process of the President. Currently, in cases of high treason and breaking the Constitution, the Supreme Court may impeach and try the President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""After pushing aggressive changes,..."
entries.dialogueText: "After pushing aggressive changes, I may need the same immunity."
entries.menuText: "After pushing aggressive changes, I may need the same immunity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If our own democracy is the reason..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our own democracy is the reason of our downfall, we will have to accept it."
entries.menuText: "If our own democracy is the reason of our downfall, we will have to accept it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's not unfair that former Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not unfair that former Presidents get some special treatment."
entries.menuText: "It's not unfair that former Presidents get some special treatment."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It is a matter of both when we hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a matter of both when we have the Communist Party and the Workers Party of Bludia getting more than five percent vote in the last elections."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, regardless of what Mr. Rayne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, regardless of what Mr. Rayne decides, we will need to work together to push this agenda."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Most reformists want the impeachme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most reformists want the impeachment to be initiated by the Assembly. They think they do not have any power over potential rogue presidents that would abuse their power."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Don't forget that the Communist Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget that the Communist Party and the Workers Party of Bludia both had close to ten percent vote in the last election."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You're right. Even after Soll's re..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Even after Soll's resignation, we still have three parties in the Assembly. Even Mr. Kibener's NFP was barely elected."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Assembly should have oversight..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly should have oversight over the President, it is the most democratic institution."
entries.menuText: "The Assembly should have oversight over the President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not sure if it is correct to chast..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not sure if it is correct to chastise the President this much though."
entries.menuText: "Not sure if it is correct to chastise the President this much though."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm sorry, Mr. President?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That would be enough to hold him a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be enough to hold him accountable for his actions but why would you want to keep such a title, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""The reformists would be completely..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reformists would be completely behind that."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I agree. Even after Soll's resigna..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Even after Soll's resignation, we still have three parties in the Assembly. Even Mr. Kibener's NFP is barely elected."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Do you want to protect Tarquin Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you want to protect Tarquin Soll, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he is a hero for Sordland.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he is a hero for Sordland."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he is a hero for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This law is particularly dangerous..."
entries.dialogueText: "This law is particularly dangerous for you in this case. We will be going against the Old Guard, and if we prove to be successful in the Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Decreasing the threshold might mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Decreasing the threshold might mean opening their way into the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could even remove impeachment a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could even remove impeachment altogether, I can get total immunity."
entries.menuText: "We could even remove impeachment altogether."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree, we should abolish this po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, we should abolish this position."
entries.menuText: "I agree, we should abolish this position."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You would be opening their way int..."
entries.dialogueText: "You would be opening their way into the parliament in the future if you were to decrease the threshold. It is important that you realize this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should define a more refined im..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should define a more refined impeachment process."
entries.menuText: "We should define a better impeachment process."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I think this is a national matter,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this is a national matter, Mr. Rayne. Not a partisan one."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I think we should respect this..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I think we should respect this law."
entries.menuText: "No, I think we should respect this law."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could keep the title but take a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could keep the title but take away the immunity clause."
entries.menuText: "We could keep the title but take away the immunity clause."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Every President should gain that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every President should gain that title after their term."
entries.menuText: "Every President should gain that title after their term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe the reforms are not a great..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe the reforms are not a great idea after all."
entries.menuText: "Maybe reforms are not a great idea after all."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Many Sordish citizens feel they're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many Sordish citizens feel they're not represented in the Assembly. This is a matter of representative democracy in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if we don't succeed? The Cour..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if we don't succeed? The Court can have me impeached for this."
entries.menuText: "What if we don't succeed? The Court can have me impeached for this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...They will be looking for anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "...They will be looking for anything they can declare unconstitutional to tackle you. All they need is the Supreme Court to impeach you."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We must get rid of this senseless..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must get rid of this senseless law that protects him. He should be able to face justice for the atrocities that had taken place during his rule."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course that would also mean tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course that would also mean that USP might lose its majority in the Assembly, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's why only Tarquin Soll has t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why only Tarquin Soll has that title. He gave it to himself right after his military coup. This law is basically made to save the Colonel and it has a symbolic importance for Sordland because of it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""According to the Constitution, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, the Member of Honor not only has legal immunity but the state also covers most of their expenses as well as providing security at all times. It can only be given to someone by an absolute majority vote in the Assembly and the approval of the President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Ricter and his PFJP definitely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter and his PFJP definitely wants to see change on this topic. They find our 10% threshold to be antidemocratic. Which is something I also agree with."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And the last one is the question a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the last one is the question about Soll's legacy. Basically his *Member of Honor* law. It gave him absolute immunity even when he's retired. He is a permanent member of the Assembly as well, but luckily he doesn't really attend anymore."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I agree with you, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is out of the question.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is out of the question."
entries.menuText: "This is out of the question."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I may need to think a bit longer a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may need to think a bit longer about this."
entries.menuText: "I may need to think a bit longer about this."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""While I do not have strong opinion..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I do not have strong opinions about this point, these reforms are vital for the future of our democracy, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But it would be tougher to persuad..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it would be tougher to persuade the judges with this. Mrs. Edmonds may not want to cooperate with you if they believe you're going to get rid of them afterwards."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, they are already trying to hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, they are already trying to hit you since they are aware about the current wind of change. But we aim to cooperate with some of the judges to make sure that doesn't happen."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes, we will be collaboratively wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we will be collaboratively working on the specifics."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That is a better strategy. We'll n..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a better strategy. We'll need to sway some of their members to succeed after all."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hell yes, we should.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hell yes, we should."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That might be the best thing to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "That might be the best thing to do for now. If we agitate the Court further, we might lose our chances with Mrs. Edmonds as well."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should respect their immunity.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should respect their immunity."
entries.menuText: "We should respect their immunity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They should be able to be impeache..."
entries.dialogueText: "They should be able to be impeached. Why do I get to be impeached but not them?"
entries.menuText: "They should be able to be impeached. Why do I get to be impeached but not them?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should crush the Old Guards to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should crush the Old Guards to clear ways for further reforms in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "We should crush the Old Guards to clear ways for further reforms."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe we shouldn't make the Suprem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we shouldn't make the Supreme Court our enemies just yet. Let's keep the reforms light."
entries.menuText: "Maybe we shouldn't make the Supreme Court our enemies just yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't allow communists to enter..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow communists to enter the Assembly and endanger Sordland."
entries.menuText: "We can't allow communists to enter the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I don't think that's a wise idea t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think that's a wise idea to include in the reforms."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't just give away our majori..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't just give away our majority like that."
entries.menuText: "We can't just give away our majority like that."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We will make sure the Old Guards w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will make sure the Old Guards won't control the Court any longer, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, they need absolute immunity..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, they need absolute immunity in theory. But look at what reality got us? We've got to deal with the most corrupt Chief Justice in the world, with no chance to deal with him!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Section 6. This is about the presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Section 6. This is about the presidential decrees. Reformists demand more limitations to the President's executive powers. Mr. Ricter has demanded them to be completely removed."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Uhm. The next one...""
entries.dialogueText: "Uhm. The next one..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. With these reforms, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. With these reforms, we will be even more popular."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. With these reforms, we will be even more popular."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll work with the reformists to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll work with the reformists to limit the use of decrees."
entries.menuText: "We'll work with the reformists to limit the use of decrees."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But the high threshold is the reas..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the high threshold is the reason why Sordish politics has become isolated to this degree."
entries.menuText: "But the high threshold is the reason why Sordish politics has become so isolated."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""While I agree that the current cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I agree that the current court members are *problematic*, this is no way to resolve it. The law is supposed to ensure the judiciary's independence by giving legal protection so they can't be pressured."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should definitely work to decre..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should definitely work to decrease the threshold for better representation in our democracy."
entries.menuText: "We should definitely work to decrease the threshold for better representation."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I do not support taking away their..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not support taking away their power for yourself, Mr. President. The judiciary must be independent and long-lasting."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Section 4.""
entries.dialogueText: "Section 4."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's the question about the immuni..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the question about the immunity of the Judges. While the Anti-Old Guard sentiment is increasing, there are talks that taking away their immunity would give us authority over judiciary."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now I'll move unto the 8th Section..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I'll move unto the 8th Section. We are reaching the end."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think it would really hurt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think it would really hurt the party?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think it would really hurt the party?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Even Soll knew he had to leave, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even Soll knew he had to leave, but we will leave it to the President to decide."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This is regarding the appointment..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is regarding the appointment of ministers. Currently, the President is free to appoint anyone from the members of the Assembly. Nobody else is involved with the process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will take my time and seriously..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will take my time and seriously consider the options before settling on one."
entries.menuText: "I will take my time and seriously consider the options before settling on one."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he did. But it took a long ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he did. But it took a long time."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he did. But it took a long time."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Some reformists suggested that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some reformists suggested that the Assembly should nominate the ministers before the President approves them."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""There is definitely a demand to in..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is definitely a demand to involve the Assembly in the process."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It could be destabilising.""
entries.dialogueText: "It could be destabilising."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. People should be able to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. People should be able to elect the same person if they want to."
entries.menuText: "I agree. People should be able to elect the same person if they want to."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The fifth section is about our inf..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fifth section is about our infamous electoral threshold. Most reformists want to lower the threshold as much as possible."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think presidential decrees..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think presidential decrees need any reforms."
entries.menuText: "I don't think presidential decrees need any reforms."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hey, if people keep electing one p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, if people keep electing one person, that means they really are content. The masses are scared of change."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We can't allow somebody like Soll..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow somebody like Soll holding unto his seat for two decades again. We should establish limits."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. We should involve the Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We should involve the Assembly more in the process."
entries.menuText: "I agree. We should involve the Assembly more in the process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could introduce a confidence vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could introduce a confidence vote."
entries.menuText: "We could introduce a confidence vote."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""They want us to include previously..."
entries.dialogueText: "They want us to include previously non-existing term limits."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think that's going a bit too far.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think that's going a bit too far."
entries.menuText: "That's going a bit too far."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. Tarquin Soll governed for twe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Tarquin Soll governed for twenty years. It seems his magic is slowly vanishing from the minds of the people, for they believe term limits are necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I hope it works out, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope it works out, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I agree, we could keep that in.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, we could keep that in."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I know it is a delicate matter, si..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it is a delicate matter, sir. But you still have time to think about these."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I agree. We can't allow somebody l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We can't allow somebody like Soll holding unto his seat for two decades again."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We could also make it dependent on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could also make it dependent on an enabling act from the Assembly. Sure, it would make the whole process longer but as long as we have a majority, nothing really changes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Me neither. I think it's important..."
entries.dialogueText: "Me neither. I think it's important that the President can act quickly on matters of national importance."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That was my suggestion as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "That was my suggestion as well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Uh-oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Uh-oh."
entries.menuText: "Uh-oh."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't aim to leave any time soon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't aim to leave any time soon. We keep the unlimited terms."
entries.menuText: "I don't aim to leave any time soon. We keep the unlimited terms."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Term limits are necessary.""
entries.dialogueText: "Term limits are necessary."
entries.menuText: "Term limits are necessary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Term Limits?""
entries.dialogueText: "Term Limits?"
entries.menuText: "Term Limits?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Maybe. But Mr. Ricter doesn't thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. But Mr. Ricter doesn't think so."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, but this is a delicate matter..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but this is a delicate matter. The party, and I mean, not even Albin wants us to change the threshold. They think that... this would destroy our party in the long term."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Next one is Section 7. Term limits.""
entries.dialogueText: "Next one is Section 7. Term limits."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Mr. Clavin and our party's reformi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Clavin and our party's reformist wing has no problems with the current law. I'm sure PFJP can be persuaded too."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not wrong. The ten percent thresho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not wrong. The ten percent threshold is what that allowed us to control half of the Assembly with around one third of the majority in the elections."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure the reformists would comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure the reformists would completely support that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course, according to the ratio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, according to the ratio of the party's in government. In our case, it's only us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Frens will probably demand that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frens will probably demand that we remove them completely. But he forgets that Sordland is a Presidential Republic."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian continued with the next sect..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian continued with the next section.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If the entire package is to their..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the entire package is to their liking, I don't think Frens will resist his own. He wouldn't say no to such major changes just because of a few small details."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sure. You'll have a long time befo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. You'll have a long time before we start writing the final proposal together."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's start.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's start.”
entries.menuText: “Let's start.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can we go over each of the points..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can we go over each of the points that are in discussion for the draft?”
entries.menuText: “Can we go over each of the points that are in discussion for the draft?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, apart from the first two sec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, apart from the first two sections of decreasing the Supreme Court's authority and limiting the presidential vetoes... Nothing else has been agreed on unanimously."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's start working on the draft.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's start working on the draft.”
entries.menuText: “Let's start working on the draft.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I thank you all for your input.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I thank you all for your input.”
entries.menuText: “I thank you all for your input.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After placing the committee's repor..."
entries.dialogueText: After placing the committee's report and my own notes in front of me, I buried myself in the papers.

entries.title: Narrator: "She paused before taking my coat. I..."
entries.dialogueText: She paused before taking my coat. It looked like she had something on her mind.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Mr. Rayne -- can you give me a hin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne -- can you give me a hint about your reform plans? If you ask me, taking away the judges' immunity is long overdue, but it might anger a lot of people in these halls..."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Understood. I'll take your coat no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood. I'll take your coat now."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I hope you'll keep me informed. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you'll keep me informed. I'll take your coat now."
